# Press kit (draft 2)

Prepared by Jonah (marketing) · 2026-09-02 · Embargoed until the public release

Quillwend, the offline-first habit journal from Nimbrel Studio, launches publicly on
**17 November 2026** on iOS, Android and the web.

## About the product

Quillwend is a journal for small daily habits. It works fully offline and syncs when a connection
comes back. Entries live on the device first; the sync service only moves them between a
person's own devices.

## About the studio

Nimbrel Studio is a four-person team. It has no outside investors.
